purpose: Pin original-source reuse-rights evidence for the KAMP and Foxconn measured-data candidates without treating public mirrors, code licences, competition access or catalog-level licences as permission to ingest third-party manufacturing data.

originalSource.identityEvidence: The independent analysis repository states that this exact KAMP URL supplied the 7,996-row, 44-column injection-moulding dataset with PassOrFail as the target label.

governmentCatalogEvidence.provider: 중소기업기술정보진흥원 (Korea Technology and Information Promotion Agency for SMEs / TIPA)
governmentCatalogEvidence.catalogDescriptionBoundary: The official Public Data Portal describes 50 manufacturing-AI datasets made freely available through KAMP for manufacturers' AI analysis and exposes per-row fields for dataset name, content, type, usage condition and download link.
governmentCatalogEvidence.catalogFileLicenceBoundary: The government catalog itself is published without a permission-scope restriction. That catalog-level permission is not treated as a licence for every underlying manufacturing file.
governmentCatalogEvidence.exactRowUsageConditionStatus: A secondary reproduction of the official catalog row reports the injection-moulding dataset usage condition as 콘텐츠 변경허용 (content modification allowed), but the exact first-party row has not yet been captured in a durable machine-readable source artifact.

mirrorEvidence.licenceBoundary: The MIT licence applies to the repository's own code/content and is not accepted as proof that KAMP granted redistribution rights over the source manufacturing dataset.

sources.nextAction: Capture the exact DATASET_SEQ=4 usage condition or dataset terms from KAMP/TIPA first-party material and verify that those terms permit automated aggregate profiling. Prefer retrieval from the original KAMP distribution. Do not promote or ingest the public mirror solely because its repository is MIT licensed.

originalSource.competitionContext: 2020 industrial big-data / intelligent-manufacturing competition, injection-moulding Task 2
originalSource.provenanceEvidence: Authoritative competition and Chinese Academy of Sciences material identifies the injection-moulding virtual-measurement/tuning task as using production data supplied by Foxconn Industrial Internet.

mirrorEvidence.repositoryDescriptionBoundary: The mirror states that it re-shared the Foxconn injection-moulding dataset because the original data no longer appeared to have a download link. The mirror supplies no repository licence and is not an authoritative rights grant from Foxconn or the competition organiser.

sources.nextAction: Obtain the original competition dataset terms/rules or written permission from Foxconn or the organiser that explicitly permits post-competition reuse and automated ingestion. Until then, keep all mirrored raw files non-executable and non-redistributable.

evidenceBoundary: This review narrows two mirror-rights blockers but changes no accepted dataset-family count, measured-sample count, automated-ingestion permission or raw-redistribution permission. KAMP has strong evidence of intentional public availability and a dataset-specific usage-condition mechanism, but the exact first-party DATASET_SEQ=4 usage condition still needs durable capture. Foxconn has authoritative provenance and historical competition access but no located enduring reuse licence.
